changes: p2: name changed from 'Viprācārya' to 'Vaṅgasena'. 'vaidya-vipra-ācārya' are titles; the name comes from 'vaṃgasenagraṃthaḥ' and is the known author of the text. 'vipra' added to titles.
Weekday: 'roja 4' read as Wednesday (budhavāra, counting Sunday as day 1).
Place: removed the normalization to Bhaktapur. 'harikṣatre' (Harikṣetra) is not a usual name for Bhaktapur and may point to Harihara-kṣetra / Sonpur near Patna, so the identification is uncertain.
Notes: rewritten to explain the place problem and the unclear 'dharyanārāyaṇavatāse'. No scribe is named.
ce_approx: kept 1844. Pauṣa śukla of VS 1900 falls around Dec 1843 / Jan 1844.

date.as_written: saṃvat 1900 sāla miti pauṣa śudi 13 roja 4

notes: No scribe, commissioner or owner is named. 'bhagatpatnanagare' could be Bhaktapattana (Bhaktapur), but 'harikṣatre' (= harikṣetre) is more typical of Harihara-kṣetra (Sonpur, near Patna, Bihar), so the place is left unidentified. 'dharyanārāyaṇavatāse' is unclear. It may be '(Dhairya/Dharma)nārāyaṇa-āvāse', 'at the residence (or temple) of ...nārāyaṇa'. It could refer to a deity's temple or to a person's house, so no person has been extracted from it. The catalogue date VS 1900 agrees with the colophon. Akṣara count 410264, śloka count 12820.
